statement: Independent review approved these values as the initial conservative Phase 10 policy (POLICY_REVIEWED_INITIAL_V1), chosen in the absence of sufficient portfolio history. Every value below is a reviewed-policy choice (POLICY) or a governed cost constant (GOVERNED_CONSTANT). None is an empirically validated quantity: the repository has no qualified portfolio history from which a limit or a stress size could be estimated (Phase 9: 0 PIT overlap days, 0 fully qualified trades). An EMPIRICALLY_VALIDATED basis is not accepted by this schema.

max_position_leverage.rationale: No single position may carry more notional than twice equity, whatever its stop distance.

max_gross_leverage.rationale: Total long plus short notional; leverage is never treated as risk capacity.

max_net_leverage.rationale: Directional exposure to the market as a whole.

max_executable_risk.unit: sum (stop risk + expected exit/entry costs + adverse funding) / equity
max_executable_risk.rationale: Expected loss if every stop is hit at its price, after fees, slippage under the liquidity authority and adverse funding.

max_asset_stop_risk.unit: stop risk of all positions on one asset / equity
max_asset_stop_risk.rationale: Several strategies on the same asset are one exposure.

max_strategy_stop_risk.unit: stop risk of one strategy / equity
max_strategy_stop_risk.rationale: One strategy's positions share one failure mode.

max_side_stop_risk.unit: stop risk of all longs or of all shorts / equity
max_side_stop_risk.rationale: Same-direction positions are exposed to the same market move.

max_cluster_stop_risk.unit: stop risk of one dependence cluster / equity
max_cluster_stop_risk.rationale: Positions whose losses co-move (direction-adjusted return correlation at or above dependence.cluster_correlation) are one exposure.

max_stressed_loss.rationale: Loss under the worst deterministic stress below; a scenario that cannot be evaluated is never treated as a pass.

approach_fraction.rationale: A metric at or above this share of its limit (and not above the limit) is APPROACHING_LIMITS.

fee_taker.unit: fraction of notional per market order
fee_taker.rationale: v8.fees/1 (tools/research/pit_cost.FEE_SCHEDULE), the taker fee quant.py charges; one schedule for every venue and date.

slippage_tiers.unit: [minimum KNOWN 24h trade-DEX volume USD, slippage per market order]
slippage_tiers.rationale: The scanner tiers used by quant.CFG['slip'] and pit_cost.SLIP_TIERS; applied only to a KNOWN v8.liquidity volume.

bar_seconds.rationale: Daily close-to-close returns from closed UTC days.

lookback_bars.rationale: Trailing window ending at the evaluation time; nothing after it is read.

min_overlap_bars.rationale: Fewer common returns make a pairwise correlation or a beta UNAVAILABLE.

cluster_correlation.rationale: Two positions whose losses correlate at or above this are clustered together.

market_asset.rationale: The market factor for beta and the down-market regime.

min_regime_bars.rationale: Down-market (market return < 0) correlation needs at least this many common down days, else UNAVAILABLE.

market_move.rationale: CORRELATED_MARKET_MOVE: the market factor moves this much up and down; each position moves by its beta, losses capped at its stop.

stop_gap_fraction.unit: extra loss beyond the stop as a share of the stop distance
stop_gap_fraction.rationale: STOP_SLIPPAGE: a stop is not a guaranteed maximum loss; fills are assumed this far through the stop.

cost_multiplier.rationale: EXECUTION_COST: execution costs at this multiple (the Phase 9 cost stress diagnostic also reports 2x).

liquidity_tier_steps.rationale: LIQUIDITY_DEGRADATION: every KNOWN volume pays the slippage of this many tiers worse.

unknown_liquidity_multiplier.rationale: The degraded bound for a position without KNOWN liquidity: never zero slippage, never a tier.

adverse_funding_8h.unit: funding rate per 8h, paid by every position
adverse_funding_8h.rationale: FUNDING_DETERIORATION: every position pays this rate against its direction for its remaining planned holding time.

tail_min_closed_trades.rationale: Below this many qualified closed trades the observed tail loss beyond stops is reported INSUFFICIENT and never used to size a limit.
